title: ShoppingListDetailView: search, toolbar, and delete-list
description: Extend `ShoppingListDetailView.swift` with: (1) `.searchable` modifier (prompt "Search items") filtering visible items by case-insensitive substring — sections with no matches are hidden during active search; (2) toolbar trailing containing a `plus` button (accessibility label "Add item", presents `AddItemSheet`) and an `ellipsis.circle` menu; (3) "Delete list" destructive menu item that presents a `.confirmationDialog` (title "Delete '<name>'?", message "This shopping list will be permanently removed.", destructive "Delete" action) — on confirm, calls `FileManager.default.removeItem(at:)`, pops the detail view, and triggers list-view refresh.
acceptance_criteria: Sections with no matching items are hidden while search is active
Toolbar trailing has a `plus` button and an `ellipsis.circle` menu
`plus` button presents `AddItemSheet`; has accessibility label "Add item"
⋯ menu contains "Delete list" as a destructive action
"Delete list" presents `.confirmationDialog` with title, message, and red "Delete" action
Confirmed delete removes the file, pops the detail view, and causes the list view to reflect the removal

handoff_summary.completed: All acceptance criteria implemented: `.searchable(prompt: \"Search items\")` with section filtering; `ToolbarItemGroup` with `plus` button (accessibility label \"Add item\") and `ellipsis.circle` Menu (accessibility label \"More options\"); \"Delete list\" destructive menu item; `.confirmationDialog` with correct title, message, and red Delete button; `deleteList()` removes file with security scope, dismisses view, and calls onDelete callback; ShoppingListsView passes onDelete closure that filters the deleted entry from entries.
handoff_summary.risks: Pre-existing build errors in RecipesListView.swift (missing expandedSections symbol) from a sibling feature may block CI until resolved. My changes introduce no new compiler errors.
handoff_summary.next_action: Hand off to tester agent for acceptance-criteria verification.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: ShoppingListsView.swift was modified (navigationDestination updated) — any sibling bead that also edits this file should be aware of the added onDelete parameter in the ShoppingListDetailView initializer call.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Used optional onDelete: (() -> Void)? = nil closure rather than a binding or environment object to keep the coupling minimal and the detail view independently usable. Security-scoped resource access on the folder URL mirrors the pattern in ShoppingListsView.handleCreate(). filteredGroups uses searchText.isEmpty rather than isSearching to avoid the need for an @Environment read, simplifying the logic.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: Key scenarios for tester: search filtering hides sections with no matches; search text clearing restores all sections; delete confirmation dialog shows correct title and message; confirmed delete removes file and returns to list without the deleted entry; cancelled delete leaves file and view intact; plus button presents AddItemSheet.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: Pre-existing build failure in RecipesListView.swift (expandedSections out of scope) is unrelated to this bead but will cause CI to fail until fixed by the responsible agent.

conflict_risks: ShoppingListsView.swift was modified (navigationDestination updated) — any sibling bead that also edits this file should be aware of the added onDelete parameter in the ShoppingListDetailView initializer call.

execution_history.summary: Extended ShoppingListDetailView with searchable filtering, a combined plus+ellipsis toolbar, and a destructive delete-list flow with confirmation dialog. Updated ShoppingListsView to pass an onDelete callback so the list view removes the entry immediately after deletion.
